transcript_full: You know how yesterday I told you we had an unusually warm winter? Well, today it's snow, but that doesn't mean my point is invalid. It's been the weirdest, warmest, and probably shortest winter that I remember. My observation is subjective, but what isn't is that the little snow has resulted in unusually low water levels. This will particularly affect agriculture and energy production this summer.
